ng-add.description: Install the shaderng runtime, wire the TypeGPU esbuild plugin, and copy the first orbs.

orb.description: Copy one or more shader orbs into the project, or save a playground look as a preset.

field.description: Copy one or more rectangular field shaders into the project.

update.description: Refresh the copied shaderng runtime and orb files that the project has not edited.
